visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic title screen featuring the text '不受控制的情侶' against a vibrant green and yellow gradient background. (2) A group of five young adults stands outside a building with a rustic stone-textured wall. A man in a green bomber jacket checks his watch and looks impatient, while a woman in an oversized white hoodie poses for a man in a purple bucket hat who is taking her photos with a smartphone. (3) The scene shifts to a sunny park. Three people are seated on a wooden bench while another man stands before them; they appear worried, checking their phones and gesturing towards the surrounding woods. (4) A wide, high-angle shot captures a grassy hill under large trees. The missing couple is seen at the top, waving enthusiastically as they begin to walk down towards the group. (5) The group reunites in the park. The couple, still holding their phone and smiling, attempts to show off their pictures, while the other four members confront them with animated hand gestures and frustrated facial expressions.
